records.rationale: Full four-path original and both e92b6ef8fc96/60701bc1fe7c reverts read. ACK explicitly removes the default-3 Kconfig restriction and residual perf_paranoid_any syscall gate. All retired names are absent in final ACK/LTS/port; kernel default stays native 2. Positive local GrapheneOS init-perfetto.rc writes paranoid=-1 on load-bpf-programs, relying on SELinux perf controls, and sepolicy grants distinct perf permissions to traced_perf, runas_app and shell. Native complete perf_event_open and SELinux open/read/write checks are preserved. Do not treat native paranoid=3 as the old blanket ban or claim SELinux equals that stricter global prohibition. Allowed profiling exposes perf machinery according to policy; enforcement at runtime is unverified and no GrapheneOS kernel_common hardening is imported.
evidence: SECURITY.md: Perf access policy and native guest callbacks

records.rationale: Full single-export patch read. Retain GPL perf_event_read_local source-module interface. Entire function body equals LTS: local IRQ protection, reject inherited events, validate current task/local or package-adjusted CPU and pinned on-CPU state, read native PMU counter and timing. Caller must own event lifetime and honor its local/NMI-safe contract; export adds no reference or new userspace access. Particular SDK module subscriber remains unconfirmed; generic instrumentation source compatibility is retained.
evidence: SECURITY.md: Perf access policy and native guest callbacks

records.rationale: Full two-path historical revert and native static-call implementation read. Restore both CONFIG_GUEST_PERF_EVENTS blocks exactly from LTS in 600ffdb50882. Original motivation was Pixel 6 ARM indirect-call CFI failure on __static_call_return0, not an Android userspace API. SDK has HAVE_STATIC_CALL=y and HAVE_STATIC_CALL_INLINE=y: static_call expands to a declared trampoline, x86 trampoline emits direct JMP, and the inline transform replaces return-zero CALL with xor5rax. This is positive architectural implementation evidence, not lack of a consumer. Keep native registration/unregistration GPL interfaces, callback signatures, null-return defaults, optional Intel PT handler and synchronize_rcu. The historical private perf_get_guest_cbs implementation helper is removed along with the workaround; supported registration and perf_guest_* interfaces remain. Native KVM callback provider is present and config-enabled. No CFI disable or type-check bypass is added; native x86 CFI-enabled compilation is being verified in build 147, while callback runtime and ARM behavior are outside this verification.
evidence: SECURITY.md: Perf access policy and native guest callbacks
